title: DSWD: LGBTQIA+ members may qualify as solo parents

blocks.text: MANILA — Members of the LGBTQIA+ community may qualify for benefits under the Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act, as the law does not explicitly exclude them, a Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) official said Thursday. “The law is clear so wala naman po tayong room for interpretation na masasabi natin na hindi kasali ang members (there’s no room for interpretation to prohibit members) of the community or the LGBTQIA+ community,” DSWD Undersecretary and Special Committee on LGBTQIA+ Chairperson Elen De Vibar Pasion said during a media forum at the agency’s Central Office in Quezon City.
